run_program_interactive: run the Program class to start an interactive chatbot session with user input and model replies
create_program_instance: create a Program instance with a view, chatbot, generator, tokenizer, and gang for chatbot orchestration
implement_programview: implement a ProgramView subclass to handle system prompts, user messages, and reply printing for the chatbot
use_messageprinthook: use MessagePrintHook to stream decoded token pieces to the view during sequence generation steps
broadcast_messages_via_gang: broadcast Message objects across gang ranks using broadcast_objects for distributed chatbot communication
